projects_one_default_per_organization_id.name: projects_one_default_per_organization_idx
projects_one_default_per_organization_id.where: "projects"."name" = 'Default' AND "projects"."domain" IS NULL AND "projects"."archived_at" IS NULL

project_site_authority_origin_check.name: project_site_authority_origin_check
project_site_authority_origin_check.value: "project_site_authority"."origin" is null or length("project_site_authority"."origin") between 9 and 261

project_site_authority_grant_check.name: project_site_authority_grant_check
project_site_authority_grant_check.value: ("project_site_authority"."status" = 'verified' and "project_site_authority"."origin" is not null and "project_site_authority"."current_challenge_id" is not null and "project_site_authority"."verified_at_ms" is not null and "project_site_authority"."verified_until_ms" is not null and "project_site_authority"."verified_until_ms" > "project_site_authority"."verified_at_ms") or ("project_site_authority"."status" <> 'verified' and "project_site_authority"."verified_at_ms" is null and "project_site_authority"."verified_until_ms" is null)

site_authority_challenges_claim_check.name: site_authority_challenges_claim_check
site_authority_challenges_claim_check.value: ("site_authority_challenges"."claim_token" is null and "site_authority_challenges"."claim_until_ms" is null and "site_authority_challenges"."status" <> 'checking') or ("site_authority_challenges"."claim_token" is not null and "site_authority_challenges"."claim_until_ms" is not null and length("site_authority_challenges"."claim_token") = 36 and "site_authority_challenges"."claim_until_ms" > "site_authority_challenges"."issued_at_ms" and "site_authority_challenges"."status" = 'checking')

site_authority_challenges_bounds_check.name: site_authority_challenges_bounds_check
site_authority_challenges_bounds_check.value: length("site_authority_challenges"."id") = 36 and length("site_authority_challenges"."nonce") = 43 and length("site_authority_challenges"."origin") between 9 and 261 and ("site_authority_challenges"."http_status" is null or "site_authority_challenges"."http_status" between 100 and 599) and ("site_authority_challenges"."evidence_sha256" is null or length("site_authority_challenges"."evidence_sha256") = 64)

site_authority_challenges_evidence_check.name: site_authority_challenges_evidence_check
site_authority_challenges_evidence_check.value: "site_authority_challenges"."status" <> 'verified' or ("site_authority_challenges"."checked_at_ms" is not null and "site_authority_challenges"."evidence_sha256" is not null and "site_authority_challenges"."last_failure" is null)

audit_attempt_lease_check.name: audit_attempt_lease_check
audit_attempt_lease_check.value: ("audit_schedule_attempts"."lease_token" is null and "audit_schedule_attempts"."lease_until_ms" is null) or ("audit_schedule_attempts"."lease_token" is not null and "audit_schedule_attempts"."lease_until_ms" is not null)

audit_attempt_limits_check.name: audit_attempt_limits_check
audit_attempt_limits_check.value: "audit_schedule_attempts"."schedule_version" > 0 and "audit_schedule_attempts"."due_at_ms" >= 0 and "audit_schedule_attempts"."expires_at_ms" > "audit_schedule_attempts"."due_at_ms" and "audit_schedule_attempts"."launch_count" >= 0 and "audit_schedule_attempts"."reserved_pages" >= 0 and ("audit_schedule_attempts"."missed_count" is null or "audit_schedule_attempts"."missed_count" > 0)

audit_schedules_calendar_check.name: audit_schedules_calendar_check
audit_schedules_calendar_check.value: "audit_schedules"."cadence" in ('daily','weekly') and "audit_schedules"."hour" between 0 and 23 and "audit_schedules"."minute" between 0 and 59 and ("audit_schedules"."weekday" is null or "audit_schedules"."weekday" between 0 and 6) and ("audit_schedules"."cadence" <> 'weekly' or "audit_schedules"."weekday" is not null)

audit_schedules_limits_check.name: audit_schedules_limits_check
audit_schedules_limits_check.value: "audit_schedules"."version" > 0 and "audit_schedules"."max_pages" between 10 and 10000 and "audit_schedules"."max_cost_micros_per_run" >= 0 and "audit_schedules"."max_cost_micros_per_utc_day" >= 0 and "audit_schedules"."max_pages_per_utc_day" >= 10 and "audit_schedules"."max_runs_per_utc_day" > 0 and "audit_schedules"."updated_at_ms" >= 0
